android.desc:
Welcome to BabyBus Kids Science! There are various science topics, wonderful exploration activities, and scientific experiments that can spark kids' interest in science and make it easy for them to understand the mysteries of science!

A VARIETY OF SCIENCE TOPICS
In this wonderful world of science, kids will learn about dinosaur mysteries, space knowledge, natural phenomena, and many other science topics! We believe that these will satisfy kids' curiosity about science and make them have fun exploring!

WONDERFUL EXPLORATION ACTIVITIES
In this world of science, there're many wonderful exploration activities, such as traveling through the dinosaur world, watching various animals up close, observing dark clouds and raining, and more! Kids can adventure anytime and anywhere, and explore any place here freely.

FUN SCIENTIFIC EXPERIMENTS
We've prepared lots of scientific experiments for kids: exploring static electricity, watching the ice, creating rainbows, making a balloon boat and more! While doing their own experiments, kids can learn a variety of scientific knowledge more intuitively and easily!

Many more interesting science activities are waiting for you in BabyBus Kids Science, so come and explore!

FEATURES:
- 64 mini-games to inspire kids' interest in science;
- 11 scientific topics such as natural phenomena, knowledge of the universe and more;
- Learn about science from 24 experiments;
- Explore scientific questions while having fun;
- Encourages children to develop the learning habit of questioning, exploration and practice;
- Supports offline mode;
- Supports to limit the amount of time your kids spend on it.

About BabyBus
—————
At BabyBus, we dedicate ourselves to sparking kids' creativity, imagination and curiosity,and designing our products through the kids' perspective to help them explore the world on their own.

Now BabyBus offers a wide variety of products, videos and other educational content for over 400 million fans from ages 0-8 around the world! We have released over 200 children's educational apps, over 2500 episodes of nursery rhymes and animations of various themes spanning the Health, Language, Society, Science, Art and other fields
—————
Contact us: ser@babybus.com
Visit us: http://www.babybus.com

quotes.text:
Some recommendations that my 6-yo daughter loves:

Specific to Math: Numberblocks: https://www.youtube.com/@Numberblocks/ She knows a little more about multiplication than what I expected.

Bonus:

Technology: The Fixis https://www.youtube.com/@Fixies The technical explanations are correct. (Videos form other channels that try to mix some science have too many technical errors.)

Bonus^2: Apps for android

BabyBus Science:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ailiyong.world.course (Good science explanations.)

BabyBus Math https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sinyee.babybus.mathIII (I didn't try it, but I guess it's good.)
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Videos explaining math intuively for children 6 to 10
